description_en: Queries the console logon settings for a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 查询指定RAM用户的登录信息
name: GetLoginProfile

parameters.help_en: The logon name of the RAM user
parameters.name: user_principal_name

LoginProfile.description_en: The console logon settings for the RAM user

AutoDisableLoginStatus.description_en: Indicates whether console logon is automatically disabled if the user is inactive. This feature is enabled by default and cannot be disabled
AutoDisableLoginStatus.description_zh: 在满足闲置禁用条件后是否自动禁用控制台登录。默认开启，不可关闭

LastLoginTime.description_en: The time when the RAM user last logged on to the console. The time is displayed in UTC
LastLoginTime.description_zh: 上次登录控制台时间（UTC时间）

MFABindRequired.description_en:
Indicates whether multi-factor authentication (MFA) is required for the user. Valid values:

false

true
MFABindRequired.description_zh:
是否强制要求用户开启多因素认证。取值：

false：不要求开启多因素认证。
true：必须开启多因素认证

PasswordResetRequired.description_en:
Indicates whether the RAM user must reset the password at the next logon. Valid values:

false.

true
PasswordResetRequired.description_zh:
RAM用户在下次登录时是否必须重置密码。取值：

false：不要求重置密码。
true：必须重置密码

PasswordStatus.description_en:
The status of the initial password. An initial password is the password that is configured when you create a logon profile or re-enable console logon.

Valid values

"NotInitial": The password is not an initial password.

"InitialValid": The initial password is valid.

"InitialExpired": The initial password has expired
PasswordStatus.description_zh:
初始密码的状态。初始密码指新创建或重新启用控制台登录设置的密码。

取值
"NotInitial"：非初始密码。
"InitialValid"：初始密码有效。
"InitialExpired"：初始密码已过期

Status.description_en:
The status of console logon. Valid values:

Active: Console logon is enabled.

Inactive: Console logon is disabled
Status.description_zh:
开启或禁用控制台登录。取值：

Active：开启控制台登录。
Inactive：禁用控制台登录

UpdateDate.description_en: The time when the logon settings were last updated. The time is displayed in UTC

UserPrincipalName.description_en: The logon name of the RAM user
